title: Trump, other Quad leaders hold meeting amid ASEAN in PH
summary: The Quad countries - the US, Australia, Japan, and India - on Tuesday held a leaders' summit in Manila towards the end of the holding of the ASEAN Summit.

blocks.text: The Quad countries – the US, Australia, Japan, and India – on Tuesday held a leaders' summit in Manila towards the end of the holding of the ASEAN Summit.

US President Donald Trump, Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese, Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi, and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi met shortly after the US leader landed in the Philippines.
According to the US State Department, the Quad is a diplomatic partnership between the four countries "committed to fostering a free and open Indo-Pacific." –NB, GMA News
